title: Ophiolite contracts registry
description: Every schema, profile and document Ophiolite publishes under contracts/, with its id, version, lifecycle and registry-relative path. The directory references nothing outside itself.

lifecycles.meaning: Served and tested; the deployment may replace it with a new id suffix inside the program without a transition release.
Qualification criteria are written in the entry (qualified_by); only additive 1.x changes; deprecation needs a transition release with an announced cutoff.
Still served until the cutoff date in the entry; consumers move to the entry named in replaced_by.

schemas.title: ContractsRegistry
schemas.description: The registry index: every schema, profile and document with its id, version, lifecycle and path.

schemas.title: ContractProfile
schemas.description: A profile document: display name, description, role, media types, representation rules and interpretation identity.

schemas.title: ScientificAsset
schemas.description: The scientific asset descriptor (envelope): exact identity, origin, representations, retention, provenance and authorization.

schemas.title: ApplicationCurve
schemas.description: A normalized LAS curve as the source stored it, with its source reference, digest and interpretation identity.

schemas.title: ScientificContext
schemas.description: Observed facts about a normalized curve: units and their status, sample and missing counts, axis order.

schemas.title: CurveWindow
schemas.description: One page of a depth window of a stored well curve: raw samples at level 0, or runs, blocks with their extrema and missing stretches at levels 1 to 17; at most 2,048 items a page.

schemas.title: CurveColumnsHeader
schemas.description: The JSON header of a curve stored as columns: the normalized curve's fields without its depths and values, which follow it as little-endian float64.

schemas.title: PointColumnsHeader
schemas.description: The JSON header of a point set stored as columns above 100,000 nodes: the normalized point set's fields without its points and attributes, which follow it as little-endian float64, one column per name.

schemas.title: AssetSummary
schemas.description: A discovery summary: identity, origin, profile, curve names and the operations allowed to the caller.

schemas.title: TypedContext
schemas.description: Observed and declared context of a typed asset (tops, trajectory, grid, triangulated surface, point set, fault sticks, seismic volume in float or 8-bit form, wavelet, rock model section, seismic section, time-depth table, feature set, well path given as positions, well set, residual result, 2D seismic line) with its fidelity report.

schemas.title: WellTops
schemas.description: Normalized well tops in source order with their source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: Trajectory
schemas.description: Normalized survey stations with their source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: GridSurface
schemas.description: A normalized regular-grid surface: every cell value in file order with its source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: TriangulatedSurface
schemas.description: A normalized triangulated surface: vertices, triangles and attributes in file order with source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: PointSet
schemas.description: A normalized point set: points and numeric attributes in file order with source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: PointSet2
schemas.description: A recipe-read point set: points in file order, number/text/category attributes with exact source labels, and the decisions that set its context.

schemas.title: ImportRecipe
schemas.description: An import recipe: columns, parsing, observation rules with precedence, declarations and the registered operations declare, select-column and mark-missing.

schemas.title: ImportRecipe2
schemas.description: An import recipe with the attributed decisions of people (E23b): /1 plus events (declare, select-evidence, clear, leave-unresolved, change), one current head per field.

schemas.title: WellCurve
schemas.description: Structural shape of an ordered well curve exchange snapshot; cross-field rules stay in catalog.validate_snapshot.

schemas.title: ScalarMap
schemas.description: Structural shape of a regular scalar map exchange snapshot; cross-field rules stay in catalog.validate_snapshot.

schemas.title: PortableBundleManifest
schemas.description: The portable bundle manifest: exact selected revisions with files, digests, served context, permitted lineage, omissions and losses (E18).

schemas.title: PortableBundleManifestV2
schemas.description: Portable bundle 2: exact selected revisions of well logs, well tops, trajectories, regular-grid surfaces, meshes, point sets, fault sticks, seismic slices, wavelets, rock model sections, seismic sections, time-depth tables and feature sets with files, digests, served context, permitted lineage and relationships; 2.8 (E23c) carries the source package, its companion members and the interpretation of a recipe-read point set or a Shapefile-read feature set; 2.9 (E107a) carries the original a file read on a computer was read from, beside the recorded reading; 1.10/2.10 (E122 s5b) carry each exported revision's source record as the gateway served it; 2.11 (E123 S1f-c) carries a packaged polyline set (Petrel fault sticks); 2.12 (E116 s1) carries a project folder block, and with it may list no assets (a folder ophiolite-mapper writes alone); 2.13 (E142 s0) carries surveys, their members by exact revision and the relations between them; 2.14 (E117 s1) carries a project folder block of its own format (ophiolite.project-folder/2), which any program may write; 2.15 (E147 s0) carries a citation block and the standard descriptors derived from it, and a media type on asset files; 2.16 (E147 s2b) describes a cited bundle's well tops, deviation surveys, time-depth tables and point sets as Croissant record sets read from their normalized data.

schemas.title: PolylineSet
schemas.description: Normalized fault sticks: sticks and points in file order with source reference, digest, context and reader identity.

schemas.title: WellLocationUpload
schemas.description: A normalized well location: one surface point in the CRS its file states, with source reference, digest, context and reader identity (E29).

schemas.title: WellLocation
schemas.description: A well's location as read: the stored point and CRS, the exact revision (and row) it came from and the association tying it to the well (E29).

schemas.title: Table
schemas.description: A table from a connected SQL database: every column with its database and logical type, the declared key, the person's declarations and the rows read, in canonical order (ADR 0020, E50b1).

schemas.title: TableFile
schemas.description: A table file kept as it is (E58b): the normalized content read from the exact original under its table-interpretation.json, whose SHA-256 it names: every column, the key, the declarations and the rows in file order with their source rows.

schemas.title: Wavelet
schemas.description: A normalized wavelet: every sample in file order with the declared kind, frequencies, sample interval, first time and polarity, source reference, digest and reader identity (E53).

schemas.title: ModelSection
schemas.description: A normalized 2D rock model: rocks with P-wave velocity and density and a rock-index grid on declared vertical and horizontal axes, with source reference, digest and reader identity (E53).

schemas.title: SeismicSection
schemas.description: A normalized 2D seismic section: every sample, one row per vertical sample, on declared axes with origin and polarity, source reference, digest and reader identity (E53).

schemas.title: TimeDepth
schemas.description: A normalized time-depth table: depth and time pairs in file order, both strictly increasing, with the stated velocity column, the declared depth type, time kind, units and datum, source reference, digest and reader identity (E57).

schemas.title: WellPath
schemas.description: A normalized well path given as positions: stations of measured depth, easting x, northing y and TVDSS (positive downward below the declared datum) in file order with strictly increasing measured depth, the declared CRS, units and references, source reference, digest and reader identity (E125 s3a). Nothing is converted or turned into angles.

schemas.title: WellSet
schemas.description: A well set as uploaded: its label and 1 to 29 members in order, each a well and a wellbore by id with one exact trajectory revision and its frame (coordinate system, wellhead, depth reference, north and an optional tie-in), or neither (E119a); a trajectory may also be saved without a frame, and placement then refuses it with frame_missing (E119a s6). Nothing is looked up, converted or filled in.

schemas.title: WellResidual
schemas.description: A residual result as a procedure run publishes it: the formation, the display unit, the surface revision and up to 10 000 rows in order, each a wellbore occurrence with its top, trajectory and crossings and either a residual in metres (the top's measured depth minus the used crossing's) or one of nine reasons none is given (E119b). Nothing is looked up, recomputed or converted.

schemas.title: FeatureSet
schemas.description: A normalized feature set: every feature of one map layer in file order with stored coordinates, attribute values by field, the stated or declared coordinate system and axes, source reference, digest and reader identity (E56).

schemas.title: SeismicVolume
schemas.description: A seismic volume description: grid, sample meaning, header decisions and per-inline chunk digests.

schemas.title: SeismicLine
schemas.description: A 2D seismic line description: every trace's position in file order (trace number, source point or none, x and y), sample meaning, header decisions, up to 64 traces that needed a decision and the digests of runs of at most 1,024 whole traces (E137 s0). Samples stay in the exact original.

schemas.title: SeismicVolumeNative
schemas.description: An 8-bit seismic cube description: grid, sample meaning, the code for no value (-128 or none), header decisions and per-inline digests of one-byte samples (E140 s0). Samples stay in the exact original.

schemas.title: SeismicVolumePublished
schemas.description: A seismic cube description as published: grid of sorted distinct observed labels, its cells and the positions without a trace, SEG-Y data format 1, 2, 3 or 5 at its own width (an integer code is its own value), header decisions and per-inline digests of the present traces' samples (E175 s0). Samples stay in the exact original.

schemas.title: SeismicSlice
schemas.description: One inline, crossline or sample slice of a seismic volume at an exact revision, with exact samples and its declared scope.

schemas.title: VolumeWindow
schemas.description: Part of a seismic volume or 2D line at an exact revision: inclusive ranges of inlines and crosslines (by label or by ordinal, never mixed) or of a line's traces in file order, and of zero-based samples; the stored 4-byte words it holds, their physical sample start and how they are cut into pieces of at most 32 MiB, with what a client checks (E141 s0). The document holds no sample.

schemas.title: VolumeWindow2
schemas.description: Part of an 8-bit seismic cube (mapping seismic-volume/2) at an exact revision, at native size: inclusive ranges of inlines and crosslines (by label or by ordinal, never mixed) and of zero-based samples; the stored one-byte codes it holds (SEG-Y data format 8, the code for no value stated as in the stored description), their physical sample start and how they are cut into pieces of at most 32 MiB, with what a client checks (E140 s3). The document holds no sample.

schemas.title: VolumeWindow3
schemas.description: Part of a seismic cube as published (mapping seismic-volume/3) at an exact revision: inclusive ranges of inlines and crosslines (by label or by ordinal, never mixed) and of zero-based samples; the stored words at their own width (SEG-Y data format 1, 2, 3 or 5), which positions have no trace (one bit each, a mask at the head of every piece and headers answer, digested once for the window), and how they are cut into pieces of at most 32 MiB, with what a client checks (E175 s0). The document holds no sample.

schemas.title: RelationshipRegistry
schemas.description: The registered relationship predicates: class, joined kinds, cardinality, exact-revision binding, asserting party and required evidence (E20); 1.2.0 (E142 s0) adds the survey kind.

schemas.title: SurveyRevision
schemas.description: One complete, immutable revision of a survey: its name, identity, producer reference and default context, every member (an exact revision in a role; a well member with its well or wellbore) and every relation between two members (E142 s0). Never served as is; a reader is served ophiolite.survey/1.

schemas.title: SurveyPage
schemas.description: One page of a survey as one reader may see it: the members the reader may read in role order, the relations whose both ends the reader may read, the authorised count and the cursor; a pinned revision or the live view (E142 s0).

schemas.title: Entity
schemas.description: A well or wellbore with an external or explicitly provisional identity, its part-of link and identity history (E20).

schemas.title: EntityAssets
schemas.description: The exact revisions associated with an entity that the caller may read, with the evidence of each association (E20); 1.2.0: with include_parts, a well's and its readable wellbores' items, each naming its entity (E66).

schemas.title: Lineage
schemas.description: One hop each way from an exact revision: parents, derivations and superseded revisions the caller may read (E20).

schemas.title: CheckRecord
schemas.description: One comparison of an output with a reference under stated rules and a tolerance: what was compared, the outcome and its differences, and who witnessed it (server, claimed or personal); a refusal names one field (E96).

schemas.title: SourceProvenance
schemas.description: Where one version came from, in three parts kept apart: identity (source system from ophiolite.source-systems/1, instance, id scheme, source object id), content (the bytes' sha256, the source's version) and context (the comparison/1 digest of how the bytes were read); observation is joined from the run, never stored (E122).

schemas.title: OutcomeDeclaration
schemas.description: An outcome as declared over a kind of result: a built-in rule and its settings (ophiolite.outcome-rules/1), the input kinds a result must be made from and the send procedure and destination label it is delivered by; the server adds the id, version, declarer and time (E120).

schemas.title: OutcomeCheck
schemas.description: An acceptance record: one outcome version's built-in rule over one exact result version of one publication, with the bound input versions, as its declarer could read them; the verdict, its reason and the rows, never changed (E120).

schemas.title: OutcomeClaim
schemas.description: A "Deliver as" claim: the outcome version, the exact result version, the acceptance record and the destination it was judged on, and its verdict; a claimed claim binds the delivery id the gate issued, a refused one keeps its reason and sentence and launched nothing; never changed (E120).

schemas.title: Verdict
schemas.description: A person's verdict on one exact result version: accepted or rejected, with a reason (required to reject, at most 2000 characters, kept as written), what it was judged against, the earlier verdict of theirs it supersedes, who gave it (a person, or an agent on a person's behalf) and when; never changed (E132).

schemas.title: BehaviourConsent
schemas.description: One step of a person's consent that a record of their own work may be used to train (training) or test (evaluation) the assistant: granted with the five items it covers and any extra, or withdrawn; ordered per person and purpose by sequence, with the text version they read; never changed (E133).

schemas.title: WorkEpisodes
schemas.description: The manifest of a folder of work episodes a model may learn from: whose work, for which purpose, what consent texts, rights bases and licences it relied on, the pseudonym salt's identity, the split rule and the counts of what was left out and why (E134).

schemas.title: WorkEpisode
schemas.description: One episode of one person's or agent's work in one project: consecutive actions less than the window apart, each with its inputs, outputs, checks, outcomes and verdicts; in shape mode only digests, pseudonyms and words of closed sets, in values mode also the values the rights allow (E134).

schemas.title: WorkTurn
schemas.description: One line of a folder's turns.jsonl: one row of a work episode as the observation (what was offered and read), the action and its judgement (checks, outcomes, verdicts, how the attempt ended), with its episode, position, mode and split; a re-arrangement of the row that converts back byte for byte (E160).

schemas.title: ProfileMigration
schemas.description: A stored item moved to a released profile version: the revision it was moved from and the new revision it was written as, the profile and stored digest of each data form, the release that ran the move and the system actor; the old revision is kept as it was; never changed (E148).

schemas.title: ResqmlRead
schemas.description: One read of one RESQML package: every part is an output (<uuid>/<role>), absorbed into a log, not read with its variant, code and sentence, or counted as context; nothing silently dropped (E124).

schemas.title: LocalFrame
schemas.description: How a package's local coordinates were placed: rotate then offset into a catalogued projected CRS, exactly, or kept local and said so (E124).

schemas.title: ResqmlObject
schemas.description: What one output landed from a RESQML package was read from: the package by its members' digests, the object and its role, its losses and parts, and the local frame of a well path or survey; no values (E124).

schemas.title: BasisGrouping
schemas.description: Files that state the same basis, or leave it open in one folder, asked once: stated blocks, proposals and singles; per member and item the stated value, then the file's override, then the confirmed answer, then unknown; conflicts shown, nothing converted (E123).

schemas.title: DerivationRecord
schemas.description: How a version was made: kind, implementation, the registry words at execution time, parameters, release, inputs by slot and lineage commitment, outputs by role, and the digest over the making (E94).

schemas.title: DerivationRecordV2
schemas.description: derivation/1 plus kind reported: a result a person or an agent made by running a catalogue procedure version, with the procedure block (version, run, envelope digest, runner, made-again-from), every input occurrence as slot[n] and the choice labels of its settings (E106). 1.1.0: the procedure block's optional verification, the tool version's verification as it stood when the result was published, with its sentence (E165 s2). 1.2.0: the procedure block's optional witness, written only when Ophiolite ran the run in the project's sandbox: the job, the image digest, the runtime, the limits, no network, the start and finish (E113 s0).

schemas.title: Parameters
schemas.description: A calculation's request and what it resolved to, as canonical typed trees: sorted object entries, ordered arrays, numbers as shortest round-trip decimal text, NFC strings (E94).

schemas.title: TableTarget
schemas.description: What a table must hold to become one type of data: its fields, the choices that describe the whole table and, for a free table, the questions asked of each column (E86).

schemas.title: DataRule
schemas.description: One released data rule: the kinds it applies to, whether it reads one file or the project, its severity, its parameters with their admissible range, comparison and source, the sentence a person reads and the registry version it first appeared in (E144).

schemas.title: RuleResults
schemas.description: The data rules run on one version under one registry snapshot: one result per rule that applies to its kind, passed, failed with a count and up to five examples, or not applicable with a reason; no id, time or person (E144).

schemas.title: SearchRequest
schemas.description: A question to every project of one organisation the caller may read: words, data types, a well, a box in a named coordinate system, a publication period, a publisher, projects and archived projects, with a cursor and a page size; an unknown key is refused, naming it (E145).

schemas.title: SearchAnswer
schemas.description: The answer to a question to an organisation: a page of current versions ordered by score rounded to 6 places, project, name and asset, each with why it matched; the count and the data type, project and well facets of every readable match; the next cursor (E145).

schemas.title: SearchAnswerByMeaning
schemas.description: The answer to a question to an organisation by meaning, served beside ophiolite.search/2: the same shape, each score the cosine of the question and the version's description (above 0, at most 1), each row naming the question's words it contains, possibly none; the count of readable matches not sent to the model (E145 s2b).

schemas.title: ToolVerification
schemas.description: A person's verification of one procedure digest in one project, against a check of a result that version reported or against a publication with a DOI or a URL, or the withdrawal of one by its author or an administrator: who and when set by the server, a statement of at most 2000 characters, never changed or deleted; a claim, never a witness, and never inherited by another digest (E165). 1.1.0: kind witnessed, against a run Ophiolite made in the project's sandbox, named by its run id and the job the server read (E113 s0).

schemas.title: ProcedureBox
schemas.description: What the server hands a tool version run in the project's sandbox, read by the SDK's ophiolite.box inside the operator's sandbox image: the entry, the settings and each exact input version at a path under /box/inputs, with its type, declarations, asset id and revision; the bundle is always /box/bundle and nothing names a host path (E113 s1).

schemas.title: HeldCopies
schemas.description: Who holds which version of an item, as one reader may see it: one row per connected copy and item with the client-declared application, the person as the reader may see them, the version last confirmed and since when, stays, follows or not said, and current, behind (by how many, and the head) or no longer readable, computed at read time; in $defs the request of exchange/holders, paged (E171 s0).

profiles.description: A LAS 2.0 text file of depth-indexed well log curves, kept byte for byte as the source stored it.
One curve from a LAS file exactly as the source stored it: original depth order and units, missing samples as null, with the reader identity that produced it.

profiles.display_name: Well log curve read in sections
profiles.description: One curve of a LAS file above 100,000 samples, stored as its depths and values in float64 after a JSON header; read in windows, never whole.
A point set of a points CSV above 100,000 nodes, stored as float64 columns (x, y, z when present, then each attribute) after a JSON header; missing values are NaN.
A curve on strictly increasing measured depth in metres with an explicit well identity and depth datum; the native protobuf exchange form.
A regular row-major grid of numeric samples with explicit units, coordinate unit and CRS status; the native protobuf exchange form.
A single-band GeoTIFF kept as the source stored it; its nodata and CRS are source declarations.

profiles.display_name: Well locations from a SQL table
profiles.description: Well records read through a reviewed customer mapping from a SQL table; current values only.

A RESQML 2.0.1 package and its HDF5 file, kept byte for byte; well paths, deviation surveys and well logs are read from it and stored with what was read and what was not. Not served through the scientific-asset envelope yet (E124).
Any approved table read as its columns and rows, with the person's declarations; current values only (ADR 0020).
A retained, exactly readable result of editing well records in a saved draft.
An approved OSDU record kind read exactly from an upstream OSDU service.
A well log stored as Parquet behind an approved OSDU record, read exactly from upstream.
An ExternalSnapshot supplied by a caller through the native protobuf API with caller-declared mapping.
A CSV of formation tops by name and measured depth, kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
A CSV of survey stations (measured depth, inclination, azimuth), kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
A regular grid of surface values in the ESRI ASCII grid format, kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
Tops in source order with names, measured depths and any provided vertical depths, the declared depth unit and basis, and the reader identity.
Survey stations in increasing measured depth with inclination and azimuth as provided (missing angles null), the declared azimuth reference and datum.
Every grid cell value in file order (first row north) with missing cells null, origin, cell size, registration and the declared CRS, units and vertical meaning.
A triangulated surface in the documented ophiolite-mesh text format (vertices, triangles, optional attributes), kept byte for byte.
A CSV of points (x, y, optional z and numeric attributes), kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
Every vertex (missing z null) and triangle in file order with attributes, extent and the declared CRS, units and vertical meaning.
Every point in file order (missing z null) with numeric attributes, extent and the declared CRS, units and vertical meaning.
A Petrel "Points with attributes" export with its README and CRS metadata, kept byte for byte and read through an import recipe (number, text and category attributes).

profiles.display_name: Petrel horizon points with inline and crossline
profiles.description: A Petrel horizon export of "INLINE : n XLINE : n x y z" rows with its CRS metadata, kept byte for byte and read through an import recipe (inline and crossline as number attributes).

A Petrel "scattered data" export (version 6: x, y, z with column and row), kept byte for byte; it lands as a regular grid when every row sits on its declared lattice, else as a point set with the sentence why.

A Petrel fault-stick export (INLINE- inline crossline x y z fault stick) with the .crsmeta.xml beside it, kept byte for byte and read without an import recipe; each run of rows with one fault name and stick number is a stick, in file order.

A Petrel well-tops export (VERSION 2) of one well, kept byte for byte; each row is a top named by its Surface at its MD, in file order with repeats kept, and the file states its depth unit. Other columns are listed as not read.
An OpendTect horizon ASCII export with x, y and z columns, kept byte for byte and read through an import recipe; inline/crossline exports are refused.
Every point in file order (missing z null) with number, text and category attributes, each field of context taken from a recorded decision.
How one source dialect is read: column roles and kinds, parsing, missing markers, how each field of context is observed and which observation wins, and only registered operations.
Fault sticks exported by OpendTect as FaultStickSet ASCII (x y z stick-index), kept byte for byte.
Every stick in first-appearance order with its points in file order and stick indices as written, with the declared CRS, units and vertical meaning.
A SEG-Y volume (revision 1 or 2, IBM or IEEE floating-point samples, big-endian, fixed-length traces on a full grid) kept byte for byte; slices are read one inline at a time.
The volume grid, sample meaning, every header decision and the digests of its per-inline chunks; samples are read as slices.

A 2D seismic line in SEG-Y (revision 1 or 2, IBM or IEEE floating-point samples, big-endian, fixed-length traces) marked by Ophiolite's exporter on its textual header line C6, kept byte for byte; every trace keeps its trace number, source point and x and y in file order.

Every trace of the line in file order with its trace number, source point and x and y, the sample meaning, every header decision and the digests of its runs of at most 1,024 whole traces; samples stay in the exact original.

A SEG-Y volume (revision 1 or 2, one-byte two's complement integer samples, big-endian, fixed-length traces on a full grid) kept byte for byte in its native 8-bit form; the value of a code is the code, and the upload states whether -128 means no value.
The volume grid, sample meaning, the code for no value, every header decision and the digests of its per-inline chunks of one-byte samples.

A SEG-Y volume (revision 1 or 2, IBM or IEEE 4-byte floating point, or 4-byte or 2-byte two's complement integer samples, big-endian, fixed-length traces) kept byte for byte as it was published; an integer code is its own value with no scale, and the grid may have positions without a trace, which are stated and never filled.
The volume grid, its positions without a trace, the sample format at its own width, every header decision and the digests of its per-inline chunks of present traces.
One well's surface point as a JSON object (x, y, the CRS it is stated in and the elevation reference), kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
One surface point with the CRS it is stated in and the elevation reference, exactly as the file states them; nothing is transformed.
A wavelet in the documented ophiolite-wavelet text format (kind, sample interval, first time, polarity and every sample), kept byte for byte.
Every sample in file order with the declared kind and frequencies, sample interval, first time and polarity.
A 2D rock model in the documented ophiolite-model-section text format (axes, rocks with P-wave velocity and density, a rock-index grid), kept byte for byte.
Every rock with its velocity and density and every grid cell as its rock index, with the declared vertical and horizontal axes.
A 2D seismic section in the documented ophiolite-seismic-section text format (axes, origin, polarity, one row per sample), kept byte for byte.
Every sample, one row per vertical sample and one value per trace, with the declared axes, origin and polarity.
A checkshot or time-depth table as CSV with the columns depth and time, optionally velocity, kept byte for byte.

Depth and time pairs of one wellbore in file order, both strictly increasing, with the velocity column as stated and the declared depth type, time kind, units and datum; nothing is interpolated or converted.

A well path given as positions: CSV with the columns md, x, y and tvdss, kept byte for byte. x is easting and y northing; TVDSS is positive downward below the declared datum. Detected from the header md,x,y,tvdss in that order; any order is read once the kind is chosen.

Stations of measured depth, easting x, northing y and TVDSS in file order with strictly increasing measured depth, and the declared CRS, map unit, depth unit, measured-depth reference (KB, DF, RT, GL, MSL) and TVDSS datum (MSL); nothing is converted, filled in or turned into angles.

An author's own list of wellbores, each with the exact trajectory revision and the frame that places it (CRS, wellhead, depth reference, north, tie-in), as one UTF-8 JSON document of at most 256 KiB, kept byte for byte. Saved in one request, never in parts; private to its author in this version.
The label and the members of a well set as uploaded, in order, with the counts of members with and without a trajectory; nothing is looked up, transformed or defaulted.

A residual per top: for each selected wellbore and each top of one formation, the top's measured depth minus the measured depth where one surface crosses the wellbore's trajectory, in metres, or the reason none is given, as one UTF-8 JSON document of at most 8 MiB, kept byte for byte. Published only by a procedure run, never uploaded, whole or in parts.

The rows of a residual result as published, in order, with the surface, the formation and the display unit, and the counts of rows computed and not computed and of selected wellbores; depths and residuals are metres; nothing is looked up, recomputed or defaulted.
A regular grid of surface values in the ZMAP+ ASCII grid format, kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it; registration is declared, never inferred.
A regular grid of surface values in the CPS-3 ASCII grid format, kept byte for byte; registration and the in-column direction are declared, never inferred.
A regular grid of surface values in the IRAP classic ASCII grid format, kept byte for byte as the uploader provided it.
An ESRI Shapefile: the .shp with its .dbf and the .shx, .prj, .cpg or .cst beside it, kept byte for byte and read without an import recipe; coordinates, axes and ring order as stored.
One feature layer of an OGC GeoPackage 1.2 to 1.4 file, kept byte for byte; coordinates, axes and ring order as stored.
A GeoJSON feature or feature collection (RFC 7946, or the older form whose crs member names EPSG), kept byte for byte; coordinates as stored.

Every feature of one map layer in file order with its stored coordinates (axes and ring orientation as stored), its attribute values by field and the stated or declared coordinate system; nothing is converted.
